title: Why women do not play jazz
summary: Julian asks why women rarely play jazz instruments except piano. Barnes thinks women simply are not interested, not that they are barred.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: A couple more things I wanted to ask you. Oh something that was curious to me. As a woman I wanted to ask you, and this is just something I think about every now and then, why don't women ever play jazz music? Except for piano. Why is that? Do you know?
You know that's one question I don't think anyone can know.
Uh-huh.
But do you know that a woman can actually do anything a man can do?
No, I didn't know that.

That's right, anything. A man may have more strength in his body than her, but the way the world is going now, you don't need strength. You need brains. Amen. And so a woman, first being asked me that question, you hear a lot about the woman's liberation. To me that sounds like a lot of foolishness. Because a woman is at liberty as much as a man. Men don't have to give her no liberty, liberation. When you've got your voting power you've got everything. The women, they've got more women than men in this country. They can vote the men after the UN's presidency, the war. They can't accept the war.
Yeah.

And they can take over and build their own factories and hire men and all. There's nothing stopping me. No law means that a woman can't have a factory or something. Well that's true. Yeah, they're calling it, they don't give them, the men don't give them jobs and the men don't have to. They can vote the factory and give the man a job. That's what I see. I think you're right.
But did you ever know of women who played music, you know jazz music, I don't mean to
play a song?
They have a few of them.

In California they had a woman that was a trumpet player when I left out Los Angeles. Well they've got a few of them that played good trumpet, they've got a few women bands. But somehow or another, what we don't understand is a woman just don't care to do those things. Carpenters, bricklayers, women can do all that but they'd rather stay home and fix up the house. Yeah, I agree with you. Yeah, they'd rather do that and take care of the children. The men, he resents that. And each goes to what they like.
It isn't that a man can't.
A man can take care of the children and put diapers on it and feed it.
A lot of them do.

Yeah, he can do everything that women do. And why is it they don't take up the instruments? Most of them will take up the piano. They don't want to be bothered with it. They've got a few of the girls now that take up the piano, but when they leave school, they're finished.

Yeah, I just wondered because like when I go to a classical symphony, there are a lot of women who play in a classical symphony. They play violin, they play bass violin, and they play the triangle and they'll play the flute and the oboe and things like that in a concert symphony but never in jazz bands.
They just don't care for it. Isn't that strange?
Yeah.
They play a piano or something like that you know. But somehow or another they just don't get interested in it. It ain't that we tell them that no you can't play it because you're a lady.
They just don't take it. Yeah, well jazz seems to really be a man jazz.
It's like now you take a harp. You didn't notice most of the women playing those harps?
Yeah.
But you've got to see a man playing a harp, huh?
I don't know if I heard that.

Yeah, very simple. But there ain't no reason why he shouldn't play it. But he don't follow the harp. But a lady will play the harp. I know it's a symphony band. I always have them ladies, the men who have to do it.
Yeah, and even in modern jazz and rock and roll and things like that women don't play that. No.
You know, even nowadays.
And they just don't want to play it. They don't want to have anything to do it. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
Yeah.
Yeah.
Yeah.
Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. If it would be to women, you know we wouldn't have any war.
